Worlds is easier to move around, and ends where it should.

Your four notes on the animated pages are live on all three of them. On phones the figure and the text now sit together. The last panel takes in the footer. Software and Coaching are one switch at the top and again at the bottom, with About beside them. The Words pages are now called the simple version, and every animated page offers it.

  • /worlds
  • /worlds/coaching
  • /worlds/about
  • PR #74
  • Issue #73

1 · Phone: figure and text together

The figure used to sit at a fixed height near the top, with the text pinned to the bottom, so short text left a hole between them (bracket). The page now measures the header and the text on each panel, sizes the figure to the space between them, and centres the two as one group. Figures also grow into spare height.

2 · The footer is part of the last panel

Scrolled all the way down, the top of the screen is now the top of the last panel, measured on all three pages at phone and desktop sizes (the panel's top sits at 0 and the footer ends exactly at the bottom of the screen). On coaching and about the footer lies over the bottom of the last world (5). On /worlds the flame room shrinks by the footer's height so the two share the last screen. Before, the extra scroll pushed the lit mark and the room's question off the top. The footer also had no background of its own, so over a light frame it was nearly unreadable (right pair, before).

3 · Software, Coaching and About from anywhere

  • 1Software | Coaching, one switch for the two offers, at the top of every panel and again in the footer. Wherever Coaching is not the current page, it carries an ember dot and outline. Switching loads the other page from the top.
  • 2About sits beside the switch, not inside it, because it is not an offer. On the about page it is underlined in ember rather than filled.
  • 3Members stays on coaching only. It sits before the switch, so the switch is in the same place on every page.
  • 4The simple version. Each hero ends with "Prefer this page without animation? Read the simple version." The footer repeats it as "Simple version".

4 · Words and Worlds are now named for what they are

The Worlds pages are the animated version and the Words pages the simple version. On the simple pages the masthead switch reads Simple | Animated (6). Every simple page still works on its own, at the same addresses. The new interface copy went into the brain's website-content page before the site, as an addendum dated 2026-10-03. It adds no claims.

How it was made

  • DesignA design agent proposed the nav: the two-offer switch, About on its own, two rows on phones, and the copy for the call-out. It checked the width budget at 360 and 390px.
  • Review 1A visual reviewer scored 6.5/10. It caught the hero gap, which came from room reserved for a caption the hero does not have, the switch shifting between pages, two navs on the last screen, and the cramped footer.
  • CodeA code and accessibility reviewer found two real bugs: the footer was unreadable under the flame room, and on short phones the figure could run into the text. It also flagged a portrait rule that JS and CSS disagreed on, and hidden controls that still took keyboard focus.
  • Review 2A fresh reviewer scored 7.5/10 with all five requests working. I took Coaching's emphasis, Members at the end, and the phone headline wraps.
  • TestsWritten first and seen failing. They check both navs, the current-page marks, the simple-version links in each hero and footer, and the Hearth link. 421 checks pass.
  • ViewportsHeadless screenshots at 360x640, 375x548, 360x740, 390x844, 768x1024, 1280x720 and 1440x900.
  • DeployThe PR was squash-merged and deployed from a clean checkout of main. The main checkout was on another session's Stripe branch, so I left it untouched. I then verified the live pages and took these screenshots from production.
  • FlameStays at the bottom of /worlds, as you said. A room that is fully on screen now counts as settled, so the wheel scrolls the conversation even with the footer showing under it.

Not done (older behaviour outside this brief)

  • RoomThe chat disclaimer under the composer is low-contrast, and particles drift over it on small phones.
  • GridThe horizon band of the grid world runs behind the kicker on phones.
  • ChartThe model-releases chart leaves its right quarter empty on phones.
  • TabletPortrait tablets use the phone layout at phone type sizes. The text could scale up there.
  • NextWhen the animated version becomes the default, give the simple pages addresses under /simple so the URL says which version it is. Visitors who ask their browser for reduced motion could then be sent there directly.
